name: Santa Cruz de Pinares (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Cruz de Pinares (a pine and a church on white and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cruz de Pinares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa Cruz de Pinares arms — pine and church
